application until a new one is passed for the same meta_info (UDS
client).
meta_info

cancellation_handler
This parameter is used to
• Query the current cancellation status by calling cancellation_
handler.IsCanceled().
Returns true in case, the current conversation has been
cancelled and false otherwise.
• Register a notifier function by calling cancellation_handler.Set
Notifier().
The registered notifier is called if the current conversation is
cancelled.

message) or readied with ErrorCode from DiagUdsNrcErrc (for an
negative response message).

the blockSequenceCounter as transferResponseParameterRecord
in the positive response.
